_note: Source registry for the tactical human performance board. Official channels first; associations and event pages are fine; trade press only as coverage or for events, always linked to the original where one exists. No vendors, no coaching blogs, no aggregators. 'coverage_only' sources can never become an item on their own.

_note_cannot_crawl: cannot_crawl records a limitation established by repeated live runs, not a guess. Such a source is still crawled every week in case the host changes, but it is reported as a known limitation rather than as a source that may have moved. Without that split, six entries would raise the same alarm every week forever and the weekly report would stop being read — which is the failure the standards watcher is built to avoid. Remove the field the moment a run proves the source works again.
